name: build-agent-skills
title_zh: 先问该不该存在，再动手写技能的技能设计师
tagline_zh: 新技能、拆冗技能、改旧技能都适用。它先帮你判断要不要做，再给结构，避免写出一个没人维护的怪物。
tagline_en: For new, overloaded, or aging skills. It decides necessity first, then structures behavior—so you never ship an.
desc_en: Design, revise, and maintain agent skills that produce reliable behavior. Use when creating a new skill, improving an existing skill, splitting an overloaded skill, or deciding whether a skill should exist at all.
why_zh: 它把「设计」和「写码」分开：先定边界、再定行为，最后才落代码。防止技能越写越臃肿，直到没人敢碰。
why_en: Separates design from coding: boundaries before behavior, behavior before implementation. Stops skill bloat before it starts.
limit_zh: 只覆盖技能的设计与重构决策，不提供具体代码模板；需要你已有明确的技能用途和大致行为预期，否则它只能给流程框架。
limit_en: Covers design and refactor decisions only, no code templates. Needs a clear use case and rough behavior spec; otherwise it just returns process.
title_en: A skill designer that asks if it should exist before you.
